digest.component_or_area: event-driven metrics reader over durable ticket event store
propositions: Event-derivation metrics must read raw event files for multi-occurrence data (attempts, rework windows, reopen counts) using reused reducer helpers (event_sort_key, is_active_event) rather than reinventing file logic, and must include compaction-retired events in the scan.
Metrics requiring only terminal state values (first_pass_rate via absent last_reopened_at, revert_recovery via reverts list) read compiled state from reduce_ticket rather than raw events.
The reader is hybrid: raw events for per-event data; compiled state for single terminal values; escalation and cross-agent handoff metrics are explicitly out of scope and report Unavailable.

Attempts_per_ticket counts distinct claim sessions from open→in_progress STATUS edges; first_pass_rate is fraction of closed tickets never reopened; rework_within_days counts closed→open→closed within n days; reopen_recovery counts tickets with ≥1 closed→open edge; revert_recovery counts tickets with substantive reverts (STATUS or COMMITS target_event_type only).

Empty date-range queries return None (Unavailable); populated ranges with zero matching events return 0 (measured zero); HLC timestamps enable exact date-range bucketing with source=structural confidence=high.
